scope: Pin original 1963 successor-regime text for teacher labor/collective activity and correct a pass-152 temporal-text ambiguity.

findings.claim: Original Private School Act Law No.1362 Article 55 directly incorporated national/public-school teacher service rules for private-school teachers.
findings.text: 사립학교의 교원의 복무에 관하여는 국ㆍ공립학교의 교원에 관한 규정을 준용한다.
findings.caution: Wikisource is a transcription, not the Gazette image; Gazette remains the primary-image target.

findings.claim: Original Law No.1362 Article 58(1)(4) expressly listed labor movement as well as political movement, collective refusal of classes, and partisan student guidance/agitation as dismissal grounds.
findings.text: 정치운동 또는 노동운동을 하거나 집단적으로 수업을 거부하거나 또는 어느 정당을 지지 또는 반대하기 위하여 학생을 지도ㆍ선동한 때
findings.correction: Pass 152 described the later official interpretation's Article 58 list without preserving that the original 1963 text itself contained the words '노동운동'. The original temporal layer must be stored separately from later amended/current wording.

findings.claim: Original Law No.1362 required disciplinary-committee consent for dismissals under Article 58(1)(2)-(5).

State Public Officials Act Law No.1325 Article 66 prohibited labor movements and other collective acts for non-official purposes, with an exception for workers in de facto labor service as prescribed by Cabinet Order.
findings.text: 공무원은 노동운동 기타 공무 이외의 일을 위한 집단적행위를 하여서는 아니된다. 다만, 각령으로 정하는 사실상 노무에 종사하는 공무원은 예외로 한다.

findings.claim: The permanent 1963 regime contained two distinct private-teacher control paths: Article 55 incorporation of public-teacher service rules and Article 58(1)(4) an express private-school dismissal ground that itself named labor movement.
findings.evidence: Original Article 58 wording independently names 노동운동; therefore the dismissal mechanism is not merely an enforcement shadow of the Article 55 -> Education Public Officials Act Article 43 -> State Public Officials Act Article 66 chain.

findings.claim: The 1963 Education Public Officials Act successor text had Article 43 titled 국가공무원법의 준용 and it remained in the 1964-01-01 version.
findings.caution: The web rendering suppresses the incorporated article-number range in the sentence body. MOLEG 11-0492 remains the official source for the range 53-67; Gazette transcription remains OPEN.

Preserve the fact that original Article 58 required disciplinary-committee consent for grounds 2-5 rather than describing dismissal as automatic.
